planets.name: WASP-157 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-157 with a 3.95-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: WASP-157 b was found in 2016 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-157. Its orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
